turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Input type}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]
    B -->|Draft prompt or task| D[PROVIDE]

    subgraph ASSAY[ASSAY: read-only]
        C --> C1[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
        C1 --> C2[Compress to floor residue]
        C2 --> C3[Name evaporated content and function]
        C3 --> C4[Locate operative sentence]
        C4 --> C5[Report ratio, erosion direction, and flags]
        C5 --> C6[Stop]
    end

    subgraph PROVIDE[PROVIDE: write]
        D --> D1{Mode known?}
        D1 -->|No| D2[Ask for HUMAN or MACHINE mode]
        D2 --> D1
        D1 -->|Yes| D3[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
        D3 --> D4{Floor passes?}
        D4 -->|No| D5[Ask up to three largest gaps]
        D5 --> D3
        D4 -->|Yes| D6[Compress task]
        D6 --> D7{Cut removed specification?}
        D7 -->|Yes| D8[Revert destructive cut]
        D8 --> D6
        D7 -->|No| D9{Two empty cuts?}
        D9 -->|No| D10{Floor still passes?}
        D10 -->|No| D11[Return last passing version]
        D11 --> D12[Present contract]
        D10 -->|Yes| D12
        D9 -->|Yes| D12
    end

    D12 --> E{Freeze this contract and execute?}
    E -->|Keep negotiating| D6
    E -->|Human signer freezes| F{Execution tools available?}
    F -->|No| G[Gate stays closed]
    F -->|Yes| H[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    H --> I{Result}
    I -->|Success| J[Done]
    I -->|Floor failure| K[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    K --> D6

    C6 --> L[This is a finding, not a draft.]
```
